no_trade_explanation: No qualifying closed-candle BUY setup was observed. Recorded blockers by unique entry candle: entry rules (10), stale or unavailable data (6).
limitations: Counts describe this recorded interval; no trades or outcomes are simulated.
Repeated evaluations of one setup count once; risk limits and open orders may block candidates.
decision_reasons counts polls; unique-entry rejection counts do not. A candle can encounter multiple blockers.
Missing entry timestamps count as one unavailable-data episode per asset, outside evaluated_entry_candles.
Older logs may report fresh quotes without recording closed-history freshness.
Logged filter results reflect the version running when the log was written.
A market-dependent 10–15 trades/hour rate is not guaranteed by these counts.
